newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche sees 96/97 sales at 3 bln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Porsche sees 96/97 sales at 3 bln dmk.

text.p: German sports car maker Dr. Ing. h. c. f. Porsche AG said on Tuesday said it expected group revenue of just over three billion marks in the 1996/1997 business year and that profits would be at least as good as last year.
Porsche chairman Wendelin Wiedeking acknowledged in a speech that his profit forecast was modest.

"My slightly reserved attitude in making this forecast is attributable in particular to the expenditure we will still be incurring in this business year on the start-up of the Boxster, ongoing investments in future projects and further expenditure on markets," Wiedeking said.
Porsche in the 1995/96 business year reported sales of 2.812 billion marks and net profit of 48.1 million marks.
